algorithm: Cycle-safe deterministic dependency propagation with evidence-gated lower, central, and upper graph bounds.
evidencePolicy: MODEL_INFERRED edges are excluded from lower and central estimates and enter only the upper missing-graph envelope.
limitations: Scenario-only reference case; it has not been compared with separated real-world outcomes.
All graph links, weights, shock magnitudes, costs, and intervention effects are explicit model assumptions.
Outputs are not forecasts, causal estimates, realized losses, or evidence of external use.
This is not sanctions screening, legal advice, or a determination that any party is restricted.
No comparable separated real-world outcome was available.
outOfScope: Investment, legal, sanctions-compliance, clinical, or emergency-response advice
